# technitium_record_https (Resource)

Manages a single `HTTPS` record in an authoritative zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_zone" "https_home" {
  zone = "https.example.com"
}

resource "technitium_record_https" "web" {
  zone            = technitium_zone.https_home.zone
  domain          = technitium_zone.https_home.zone
  svc_priority    = 1
  svc_target_name = "."
  svc_params = {
    alpn = "h2,h3"
    port = "443"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The record's domain name, for example `www.example.com`. Use the zone name for a record at the zone apex.
- `svc_params` (Map of String) The service parameters, as keys to values. For example `{ alpn = "h2,h3", port = "53443" }`. Leave out `ipv4hint` and `ipv6hint` when `auto_ipv4_hint` or `auto_ipv6_hint` fills them in.
- `svc_priority` (Number) The priority. `0` makes the record an alias for `svc_target_name`; otherwise lower values are preferred.
- `svc_target_name` (String) The target domain name. `.` means the record's own domain.
- `zone` (String) The authoritative zone that holds the record.

### Optional

- `auto_ipv4_hint` (Boolean) Fill the `ipv4hint` service parameter from the target's `A` records.
- `auto_ipv6_hint` (Boolean) Fill the `ipv6hint` service parameter from the target's `AAAA` records.
- `comments` (String) Comments stored with the record.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable the record without deleting it. Defaults to `false`.
- `expiry_ttl` (Number) Deletes the record automatically this many seconds after it was last modified. Terraform then creates it again on the next apply. Defaults to `0`, which keeps the record.
- `ttl` (Number) The record TTL in seconds. Defaults to the default record TTL in the server settings.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# svc_params is a map, so use the JSON form of the identity attributes
terraform import technitium_record_https.web '{"zone":"https.example.com","domain":"https.example.com","svc_priority":1,"svc_target_name":".","svc_params":{"alpn":"h2,h3","port":"443"}}'
```
